chunks: From him, from Safwan, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who loses consciousness and then regains consciousness. He said: He makes up what he missed; he gives the adhan for the first one and performs the iqamah for the remainder.

key_terms.الْأُولَىٰ: the first of the missed prayers
key_terms.مَا فَاتَهُ: what he missed during the period of unconsciousness
key_terms.يَقْضِي: makes up missed obligatory acts, here missed prayers
key_terms.يُؤَذِّنُ: pronounces the adhan, the call to prayer
key_terms.يُقِيمُ: pronounces the iqamah before beginning prayer

ai.seo_question: What should a person do about missed salat after regaining consciousness from unconsciousness?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who was unconscious and then recovers. It states that he must make up the prayers he missed, giving the adhan for the first missed prayer and the iqamah for the remaining prayers.
